name: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio（TP=4 · DCP4）
description: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio（Int4-Int8Mix unpruned）四节点 TP=4 + DCP4 服务：AEON v0.27.1 平台镜像 + b12x + spark-kit 生产 overlay（B12X MLA SPARSE + a2a + MTP k=2 + nvfp4_ds_mla + 315,968 上下文）；镜像构建于 spark-kit 生产 V1 配置。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-glm52:
    image: ${GLM52_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/glm52-dcp4:v0.27.1-spark-kit}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8210}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "64gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
      nofile: 1048576
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      # 生产 launcher 把权重挂在 /cache/huggingface（HF_HOME 指向它）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      # Triton / CuTe / cute-dsl 编译缓存挂在已持久化的 HF 缓存内，容器重建不丢
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "${TRITON_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.tritoncache-glm52}"
      B12X_CUTE_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR: "${B12X_CUTE_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.b12x_cute_cache}"
      CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR: "${CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.cute_dsl_cache}"
      # 源 launcher LD_PRELOAD 一个随缓存分发的 NCCL 2.30.4，路径必须存在于节点缓存
      LD_PRELOAD: "${NCCL_LD_PRELOAD:-}"
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: "${VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1}"
      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "${VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1800}"
      # ── spark-kit 生产栈（launch_gx10.sh，生产 V1 配置）──
      VLLM_ONE_GPU_PER_NODE: "${VLLM_ONE_GPU_PER_NODE:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_SPARSE_INDEXER: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_SPARSE_INDEXER:-1}"
      VLLM_BUILDA_BMM: "${VLLM_BUILDA_BMM:-1}"
      VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD: "${VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD:-1}"
      VLLM_MOE_MARLIN_ATOMIC_ADD: "${VLLM_MOE_MARLIN_ATOMIC_ADD:-1}"
      KV_FP8_ROPE: "${KV_FP8_ROPE:-1}"
      R17_DRAFT_TEMP_SCALE: "${R17_DRAFT_TEMP_SCALE:-1.0}"
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      CUTE_DSL_ARCH: "${CUTE_DSL_ARCH:-sm_121a}"
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
      # 网络：双 rail RoCE，HCA 由 hca 自动键逗号分隔填充；GID 每启动动态解析
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS: "${NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS:-4}"
      NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS: "${NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS:-4}"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "${NCCL_CROSS_NIC:-1}"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        export CUDA_HOME="$${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}";
        export CUDA_PATH="$${CUDA_PATH:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export CUDAToolkit_ROOT="$${CUDAToolkit_ROOT:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}";
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${GLM52_MODEL_PATH:-QuantTrio/GLM-5.2-Int4-Int8Mix}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-glm-5.2-quanttrio}
        --host ${VLLM_HOST:-0.0.0.0}
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8210}
        --trust-remote-code
        --reasoning-parser glm45
        --tool-call-parser glm47
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --enable-prefix-caching
        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --attention-backend B12X_MLA_SPARSE
        --disable-custom-all-reduce
        --tensor-parallel-size 4
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1
        --decode-context-parallel-size 4
        --dcp-comm-backend a2a
        --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2,"draft_tensor_parallel_size":1,"attention_backend":"B12X_MLA_SPARSE","quantization":"compressed-tensors","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}'
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-315968}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-16}
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-4096}
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.90}
        --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4_ds_mla
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --cpu-distributed-timeout-seconds ${CPU_DIST_TIMEOUT:-1800}
        --safetensors-prefetch-num-threads 16
        --watermark 0.02
        --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[3,6,9,12]}'
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-4}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-29501}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: 阿里云 ACR 平台镜像：AEON v0.27.1(sm_121a) + b12x@334a2d75 + spark-kit 生产 overlay
variables.help_en: Aliyun ACR platform image: AEON v0.27.1 (sm_121a) + b12x@334a2d75 + spark-kit production overlays

variables.label: 模型路径
variables.help: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio unpruned 权重（按 repo id 离线解析）；也可填缓存内 snapshot 绝对路径
variables.help_en: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio unpruned weights (resolved offline by repo id); or an absolute snapshot path in the cache

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 生产 315,968（须 64 对齐，否则并发下崩溃）

variables.label: 单批最大 token 数
variables.help: 生产 4096；DCP4 下勿用 8192（启动失败）
variables.help_en: Production 4096; do not use 8192 at DCP4 (fails to boot)

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 生产 0.90（保 KV 池；降到 0.87 会 evict 深会话）
variables.help_en: Production 0.90 (protects the KV pool; 0.87 evicts deep sessions)

variables.label: 分布式 CPU 超时秒
NCCL LD_PRELOAD 路径
variables.help: 留空 = 镜像自带 NCCL；仅 NCCL wedge 研究时填 nccl-2.30.4 路径
variables.help_en: Empty = the image's bundled NCCL; set only for NCCL wedge research

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 4 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 4-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled per role: empty on head, 1 on workers (required for mp multi-node coordination)

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: 源双 rail：rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0；hca 自动键按节点返回逗号分隔多 rail
variables.help_en: Source dual-rail: rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0; the hca auto key returns comma-separated rails per node

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: 源为 2 网卡列表，auto 返回首选 RoCE 口；多 rail 场景可手工覆盖
variables.help_en: Source uses a 2-interface list; auto returns the preferred RoCE interface; override for multi-rail

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析（源 launcher 用脚本每次动态解析）
variables.help_en: Per-node/per-HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolved (source launcher resolves dynamically each boot)

description_en: 4-node TP=4 + DCP4 serving for GLM-5.2 QuantTrio (Int4-Int8Mix unpruned): AEON v0.27.1 platform image + b12x + spark-kit production overlays (B12X MLA SPARSE + a2a + MTP k=2 + nvfp4_ds_mla + 315,968 context); image built from the spark-kit production V1 profile.
